tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background. Decided (D14.6) in dark; light value proposed.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on background, card and surface-2. 13:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface-1: cards (transfer, captain, trace rows). Decided in dark (D14.6).

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet, side panel, menus. Same as card.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Surface-2: nested areas inside a card (Why box, alternatives rows), secondary buttons. Decided in dark (D14.6).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: shadcn muted background: skeletons, disabled fills.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels, meta lines, hints. Passes 4.5:1 on background, card and secondary in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: shadcn accent = hover background for menu items and ghost buttons. NOT the brand orange; that is primary.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent hover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: THE brand accent, the single look-here colour (D14.7): primary button, top-pick border, captain badge, focus ring. One emphasis per card. Light value decided (D14.6) but is 4.29:1 on white: below 4.5:1 for normal text, so use it for fills, borders and text 24px+ only, or adopt primary-hover for small text.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary. Dark value decided; light value proposed (passes 4.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary fills. Dark: ink on orange 7.5:1 (white on orange fails at 2.4:1). Light: white on #C25E00 is 4.29:1, OK for 16px semibold button labels only.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn destructive: delete my data, irreversible actions.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on destructive fills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, chips. Decided in dark (D14.6).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form field borders; stronger than border so fields pass 3:1 against their ground. Proposed.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, offset 2px.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains: receipts in the green, easy fixtures. Decided in dark (D14.6). Never in the same component as primary (D14.8). Dark: 4.31:1 on secondary, so on secondary use it for 24px+ numbers or with a +/- sign and label.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, hard fixtures, errors. Decided in dark (D14.6). Dark: only 3.77:1 on card and 3.17:1 on secondary, so small negative text sits on background, or is 24px+, or pairs with a minus sign and label.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending receipts, neutral states. Decided in dark (D14.6). 4.53:1 on card; fails on secondary (3.8:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: PROPOSED for D14.9: an orange-red distinct from the accent. Hue alone cannot separate it from primary or negative (lightness ratio about 1.3:1), so every warning must carry an icon and a text label. Use only on background or card.

tokens.name: fdr-2
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 1-2 (easy) chip fill, with ink text and the number. Proposed scale for D14.8.

tokens.name: fdr-3
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 3 (neutral) chip fill. Proposed.

tokens.name: fdr-4
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 4 chip fill, with the number. Proposed.

tokens.name: fdr-5
tokens.usage: Fixture difficulty 5 (hardest) chip fill, white text, with the number. Proposed. Always show the number: red/green alone fails colour-blind users.

tokens.name: fdr-5-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on fdr-5 chips: white in both themes (5.9:1 dark, 9:1 light).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the bottom sheet, side panel and info panels.
